name: Sakuragi Silk
source:
Silk is [url=https://vndb.org/c27885]Takashi[/url]'s wife and they have been married for 3 years so far. She certainly looks Japanese, but her true origin is actually that of a totally another world. Neither Silk nor Takashi have let slip the secret of her true origin in their time spent together. But that is about to change once a new [url=https://vndb.org/c27892]Silk[/url] appears before [url=https://vndb.org/c27886]Takuya[/url] and the happily married couple.

[Edited from [url=https://www.gamefaqs.com/pc/915699-target-pheromone/faqs/29067]Ben Woodhouse's Walkthrough[/url]]
